the piezoresistors based on SiNWs are very sensitive to the compressive strain and can be used for pressure sensor applications.

the SiNW-based pressure sensor has good stability and reproducibility in the dynamic cycling test, which can be applied to the pressure measurement in the harsh environments.

the SiNWs are capable of sustaining a large compressive strain and the SiNW-based pressure sensor is capable of sustaining the dynamic cyclic testing within the working range of the sensor.

the piezoresistivity of SiNWs is not affected by the strain levels of higher than 2.2% under the static test and 1.3% under the dynamic test, but a drift of initial resistance occurs when the compressive strain is higher than 1% under the dynamic cycling test.
the piezoresistivity of SiNWs can be utilized for pressure sensing with a high sensitivity of more than 10.5 kPa(-1) under the extralarge compression of up to 2.1%.
